task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a dark, cylindrical surgical instrument entering from the lower left, its tip manipulating a small, light blue, looped suture or clip against a backdrop of pale, yellowish-white peritoneal tissue. The tissue surface is marked by fine, branching red blood vessels and scattered dark brownish-red spots of minor bleeding or coagulation. As the instrument works, the camera angle shifts slightly downward and to the right, revealing a cluster of bright orange-yellow, lobulated fatty tissue, likely omentum, in the lower right quadrant of the frame. The instrument continues to adjust the blue suture near the junction of the pale tissue and the orange fat, with the surrounding area appearing moist and glistening under the surgical light.

A laparoscopic view shows a dark, cylindrical surgical instrument entering from the lower left, its tip manipulating a small, light blue, looped suture or clip against a backdrop of pale, yellowish-white peritoneal tissue. The tissue surface is marked by fine, branching red blood vessels and scattered dark brownish-red spots of minor bleeding or coagulation. As the instrument works, the camera angle shifts slightly downward and to the right, revealing a cluster of bright orange-yellow, lobulated fatty tissue, likely omentum, in the lower right quadrant of the frame.
